section.p: Consider a "Supported Platforms" chapter in a "Product Reference Guide" document where you need to document the operating systems, browsers, and architectures supported by the application.
section.codeblock: Supported Platforms The application supports the following operating systems and browser environments. Supported Platforms Platform Version Notes Windows 10, 11 Supported on x64 architectures. Ubuntu Linux 22.04 LTS Server and desktop editions supported. Google Chrome Current Release Recommended browser for administration tasks. Mozilla Firefox Current ESR Fully supported.
section.p: Result: Using a CALS <table> when documenting supported platforms allows captions, structured columns, and easy comparison across operating systems, browsers, and hardware architectures.
